column1: # The 60 render-pass-registry teardown wrappers — DECLARED FAMILY (2026-09-15)
# Uniform shape: 12 B  lea rcx,[node] ; jmp 005DDD60  — registered with MSVC atexit
# wrapper 00808B90 by TAIL CALL from each static-init registration site (the 13ap
# blind-spot spelling). Every row re-derived at the image: name string, node address,
# and teardown target all verified. Registration shape: lea rdx,[name]; lea rcx,[node];
# call 005DC6F0 (stores name/next/flag/-1, calls REGISTER 005FDCB0); lea rcx,[teardown];
# jmp 00808B90. flag (+0x10) is 0 at all 60 sites; +0x18 = -1.
